title: Arcjet
definition: An arcjet is an electrothermal thruster. An electric arc passes through a flowing propellant, raising its enthalpy. A converging-diverging nozzle then turns part of that thermal energy into directed exhaust momentum.[^1][^2][^5] The exhaust may be partly ionised, but electric or magnetic fields do not provide the main acceleration. That distinguishes an arcjet from Hall-effect and gridded ion thrusters. It also differs from a resistojet, whose propellant receives heat through a resistive element or heat exchanger rather than a free arc.
